mapper.select: SELECT COM_EXAM_NO, USER_ID, COM_EXAM_NAME, TO_CHAR(COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE FROM COMPANY_EXAM
SELECT COM_EXAM_NO , USER_ID , COM_EXAM_NAME FROM COMPANY_EXAM WHERE COM_EXAM_NO = #{comExamNo}

SELECT COM_EXAM_NO , USER_ID , COM_EXAM_NAME , TO_CHAR(COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE FROM COMPANY_EXAM WHERE (USER_ID = #{userId} OR USER_ID = 'testCompany') AND COM_EXAM_DEL_DATE IS NULL ORDER BY COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT ce.COM_EXAM_NO, ce.USER_ID, ce.COM_EXAM_NAME, ce.COM_EXAM_DEL_DATE, cq.COM_QUESTIONS_NO, cq.COM_EXAM_NO, cq.COM_EXAM_CONTENTS, cq.COM_EXAM_QUEST_DEL_DATE, co.COM_OPTION_NO, co.COM_QUESTIONS_NO, co.COM_OPTION_CONTENT, co.COM_OPTION_CORRECT_YN, co.COM_OPTION_DEL_DATE FROM COMPANY_EXAM ce LEFT JOIN COM_EXAM_QUESTIONS cq ON ce.COM_EXAM_NO = cq.COM_EXAM_NO AND cq.COM_EXAM_QUEST_DEL_DATE IS NULL LEFT JOIN COM_EXAM_OPTION co ON cq.COM_QUESTIONS_NO = co.COM_QUESTIONS_NO AND co.COM_OPTION_DEL_DATE IS NULL WHERE ce.COM_EXAM_NO = #{comExamNo} AND ce.COM_EXAM_DEL_DATE IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY_EXAM SET COM_EXAM_NAME = #{comExamName}, COM_EXAM_CREATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE COM_EXAM_NO = #{comExamNo}
